scripts.build: pnpm -r --if-present build && python3 -m compileall -q apps/ai-gateway/src apps/agent-runner/src
scripts.quality:canary: pnpm quality:replay && pnpm exec vitest run packages/shared/test/learning-design-v3.test.ts packages/shared/test/quality-corpus.test.ts apps/workflow-runner/test/project-pipeline-v2.test.ts apps/workflow-runner/test/quality-evaluator-v3.test.ts apps/workflow-runner/test/embedding-v3.test.ts && pnpm quality:evaluator-live
scripts.test:python: PYTHONPATH=apps/ai-gateway/src python3 -m unittest discover -s apps/ai-gateway/tests && PYTHONPATH=apps/agent-runner/src python3 -m unittest discover -s apps/agent-runner/tests
